steps.description: Fit DESeq2 with ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment, explicit reference levels (WT, vehicle), minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples), median-of-ratios size factors. Primary test: Wald test on the interaction coefficient (does the drug effect differ between KO and WT). Secondary named contrasts: drug effect in WT (main treatment coefficient) and drug effect in KO (treatment + interaction), and the genotype effect under vehicle. Shrink reported LFCs with ashr (interaction and simple-effect contrasts are not single coefficients); keep unshrunken LFC, lfcSE and the p-values from the unshrunken fit. BH adjustment at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, per contrast. Flag and report Cook's-distance NA genes. Robustness: repeat the interaction test with edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same counts and report the overlap. Rank and plot on the shrunken LFC.

plan.title: Genotype-by-treatment interaction DE in brain (DESeq2 2x2)
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question is whether the drug effect differs between knockout and wild type — a difference of differences, i.e. the genotype:treatment interaction of the 2x2 factorial design (WT/KO x vehicle/drug, 4 replicates per cell, 16 samples, 12,000 genes, raw integer counts from Salmon, human brain). The flow: (T1S1) sample-structure QC on variance-stabilized counts (blind vst, PCA, sample distances, library sizes) to confirm the four design cells behave as intended before any test; (T1S2) a single DESeq2 model ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment with explicit reference levels, minimal low-count pre-filter, median-of-ratios size factors, a Wald test on the interaction coefficient, ashr-shrunken log2 fold changes for reporting, and BH adjustment with independent filtering at alpha 0.05; (T1S3) a report that presents the interaction contrast beside the two simple drug effects (drug effect in WT, drug effect in KO) with fit diagnostics, the p-value histogram, a DESeq2-vs-edgeR overlap as a robustness check (edgeR 4.10.3 is installed), and the reproducibility record. At 4 replicates per cell the interaction coefficient carries a large standard error — power is low, and the report states this rather than treating a null interaction as evidence of no difference.

steps.method: vst blind, PCA on 500 top-variance genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes
DESeq2 Wald test on interaction coefficient with apeglm/ashr shrinkage
results tables with unshrunken and shrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE, padj, contrast labels, MA and dispersion diagnostics

plan.description: Track T1 answers the interaction question directly: the research question is whether the drug effect differs between knockout and wild-type brain, which is exactly the genotype-by-treatment interaction coefficient of the 2x2 design. One track, one agent, 16 samples (12000 x 16 integer counts from Salmon, gene symbols as keys; metadata.csv carries sample, genotype, treatment, condition). Method steps T1S1 through T1S3 follow the validated Inflexion procedure (snapshot 2026-09-06, digest sha256:90c68758...) and satisfy the plan constraint: the track delivers differential expression of the interaction comparison only, with no unrequested enrichment or signature work. T1S2 grounds the effect sizes in a DESeq2 Wald test on the interaction term of the genotype (WT vs KO) by treatment (drug vs vehicle) design, adjusted with Benjamini-Hochberg at alpha 0.05, and reports the per-gene simple effects beside the interaction contrast; it also states the power caution that an interaction difference-of-differences carries a large standard error at 4 replicates per cell.
deliverables: 1. Sample structure QC report: per-sample library sizes and size factors, size-factor distribution, PCA (vst blind, 500 top-variance genes colored by genotype and treatment), Euclidean sample distance heatmap, per-cell replicate grouping, outlier / suspect sample flags.

2. Differential expression results: DESeq2 results table for the genotype-by-treatment interaction (coefficient genotypeKO:treatmentdrug or its equivalent per the chosen contrast formulation), with log2FoldChange (unshrunken), ashr-shrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE, Wald statistic, p-value, BH-adjusted padj, baseMean, and per-gene simple effects (drug effect in WT, drug effect in KO, genotype effect under vehicle) computed per the DESeq2 vignette interaction guidance.

3. Consolidated analysis report: method statement naming DESeq2 version and contrast triplets, model design formula, alpha and selection threshold, n genes tested after filtering, n significant interaction genes, MA and dispersion fit diagnostics, direction summary for the interaction, and the reproducibility record (sessionInfo, seeds, package versions, data versions).

4. Machine-readable artifacts: results table (CSV) keyed on gene symbol, per-gene simple-effect table (CSV), and analysis metadata (JSON) with the exact design formula, factor levels, contrast definitions, and DESeq2 model version.
plan.objective: Determine whether the drug acts differently in knockout than in wild type: test the genotype-by-treatment interaction in a 2x2 factorial bulk RNA-seq design (human, brain, 12000 genes, 16 samples, 4 replicates per cell) and report which genes and how many show a significant difference of drug effects between KO and WT.
